# Pinky Nails Lounge

> Family-friendly nail lounge based in Hutto, Texas. Gel, French tips, nail art and relaxing pedicures on Exchange Blvd. Walk in, get greeted by name, and leave with a set you can't stop looking at.

- Phone: (512) 846-2605
- Based in: Hutto, TX
- Nearby areas: Hutto, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Taylor, Georgetown
- Google rating: 4.6 from 157 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/pinky-nails-lounge/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/pinky-nails-lounge/book.html

## Services
- Gel & French manicures: Glossy gel color in every shade on the chart, and French tips with perfectly smooth, even lines.
- Nail art & designs: Hearts, stars, cherries, leopard, flames and glitter. Bring a picture or let us get creative.
- Pedicures: Sit back for a pedicure with a massage that isn't rushed, finished with color that sparkles.

## About
Pinky Nails Lounge sits at 143 Exchange Blvd in Hutto, and it runs like a family place. Regulars talk about the people first: Kelly, Annie, Queenie and Andy, and a team that greets everyone by name. Moms bring daughters, sisters come in together, and kids get treated like real clients. When a client needs extra patience, whether it's a father-in-law with dementia or someone who picks at their nails, the team slows down and makes it work. Walk-ins are welcome. Saturdays fill up quickly, so plenty of regulars book ahead online.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Walk-ins are welcome and we'll fit you in when we can. We do get busy, especially Saturdays, so booking online or calling (512) 846-2605 ahead saves you a wait.
- Q: Can I bring my kids?
  A: Absolutely. Kids are welcome and our team talks to them, not around them, so they enjoy their visit as much as you do.
- Q: Can you help a family member who needs extra patience?
  A: Yes. Clients have brought in older relatives, including a father-in-law with dementia, and the team kept everyone calm and comfortable. Let us know when you book.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 10 am to 7 pm, Saturday 9:30 am to 6 pm, closed Sunday.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 143 Exchange Blvd #200 in Hanson's Corner, Hutto, TX 78634, just off US-79.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online any time, use the form on this site, or call (512) 846-2605.
